Welcome.desc: Overview of EL and where to start reading.

Declaring Variables.desc: How to declare a variable, supported data types, and default values.

Assignment & Updates.desc: Assigning, incrementing, and compound-updating a variable's value.

Scope: Global & Local.desc: How global and local variables work, and why EL doesn't allow shadowing.

str.desc: The str data type, including sized strings and truncation.

The NONE Value.desc: EL's universal 'no value yet' value, and how it behaves in math and conditions.

Arrays.desc: Declaring, indexing, and using array variables.

Initial Values.desc: Setting default/initial values for array variables.

Logical Operators.desc: The or, and, and not operators.

Arithmetic.desc: Arithmetic operators, operator precedence, and int/float division rules.

Sized Strings.desc: Fixed-size strings, default size, and truncation behavior.

print.desc: Printing text, variables, and expressions to the console.

input.desc: Reading input from the console, with or without a prompt.

If / Else.desc: if, else, and else if statements, one-line statements, and empty blocks.

For Loop.desc: The for loop: initialization, condition, and increment/decrement.

Exit Statement.desc: Stopping program execution early with exit.

Array Parameters.desc: Passing arrays into a function, by list, variable, or broadcast.

Return.desc: Returning a value from a function with return.

Returning Arrays.desc: Returning an array from a function.

Recursion.desc: How EL supports recursive function calls.

Compile-Time Errors.desc: Errors reported by ELVM before your program runs.

Runtime Errors.desc: Errors reported by ELVM while your program is running.
